company.name: Bouvet ASA
company.summary: Bouvet ASA provides consultancy services in the fields of information technology and digital communication for public and private sectors in Norway, Sweden, and internationally. The company also provides spanning from strategy and management to system development, design, insight and analysis, artificial intelligence, data, and architecture. It serves sectors such as oil, gas and renewables, power supply, public administration and defence, industry, service provision, health, information and communication, transportation, and retail. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.

narrative.company_subtitle: Bouvet ASA – IT consulting & digital services in Norway and Sweden
narrative.company_headline: 8.2% revenue CAGR, 13.4% EBITDA margin and a net cash balance sheet — market cap NOK 4.9bn
highlights: **Consistent growth:** revenue compounded at 8.2% p.a. over 2022–2025, reaching NOK 3,912m
**Margin profile:** pre-IFRS 16 EBITDA margin of 13.4% in 2025A (down from 14.1% in 2022A), EBIT margin 12.4%
**Cash generative:** unlevered FCF of NOK 276m in 2025A, 53% of EBITDA, ROIC 87%
**Balance sheet:** net cash of NOK 160m, no financial leverage
narrative.market_subtitle: Bouvet versus its peer group: growth, profitability and the drivers behind the case
narrative.market_headline: Peer benchmarking on a consistent basis
opportunities: **Public-sector digitalisation** in Norway keeps demand for senior consultants high
**Energy transition** clients (grid, oil & gas, renewables) grow their IT budgets
disruption: **Generative AI** raises consultant productivity but pressures billable hours
threats: **Wage inflation** outpacing price increases would compress margins
**Public-sector budget cuts** could reduce framework-agreement volumes
financial_commentary: **Bouvet grew revenue by -0.2% in 2025A** to NOK 3,912m, with pre-IFRS 16 EBITDA of NOK 525m (13.4% margin)
**We forecast 2026E revenue of NOK 3,970m (+1.5%)**, anchored on consensus (2 analysts), fading to 2.0% terminal growth by 2031E
**EBITDA margin path:** 13.5% in 2026E to 13.6% in 2031E; D&A 1.3% and capex 1.0% of revenue; tax rate 22%
**Unlevered FCF** rises from NOK 391m to NOK 505m over the forecast period (10.0% FCF margin in 2031E)
**Valuation vs peers:** Bouvet trades at 9.5x LTM EV/EBITDA versus a peer median of 9.0x (+6%) and 14.8x P/E versus 14.7x
**Street view:** consensus target of NOK 50.00 across 2 analysts (+5% vs current price)
narrative.valuation_subtitle: We recommend a BUY. Our 12-month target price of NOK 77.00 implies +62% upside and a +69% total return including dividend; 8.8x 2026E EV/EBITDA.
narrative.valuation_headline: DCF fair value NOK 74.00, peer multiples NOK 46.77, scenario-weighted NOK 76.10 versus a share price of NOK 47.40 — BUY
market_implied: **Market-implied WACC 12.0%**, above our 8.3%: the price discounts our cash flows at 369bp more than we do
**Market-implied margin:** at our WACC the price is consistent with a 2031E EBITDA margin of 8.9% versus 13.6% in our base case

**Cross-check – low agreement:** the DCF is 58% above the peer-multiple value (NOK 46.77) and our target is 54% above the consensus of 2 analysts (NOK 50.00); the recommendation rests on the DCF assumptions alone — treat the target as a hypothesis, not a result
scenario_commentary: **Bear (25%):** Growth 2pp lower, margin 1.5pp lower, WACC +50bp; revenue CAGR 2.3%, 2031E margin 12.1%, WACC 8.8% gives NOK 52.93 (+12% vs price)
**Base (50%):** Base-case drivers; revenue CAGR 4.3%, 2031E margin 13.6%, WACC 8.3% gives NOK 74.00 (+56% vs price)
**Bull (25%):** Growth 2pp higher, margin 1.5pp higher, WACC -50bp; revenue CAGR 6.3%, 2031E margin 15.1%, WACC 7.8% gives NOK 103.49 (+118% vs price)
thesis: **DCF value of NOK 74.00 per share** (WACC 8.3%, terminal growth 2.0%); terminal value is 72% of EV, implying 11.9x exit EV/EBITDA
**Peer multiples imply NOK 46.77** per share (median of EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT and P/E-based values)
**Scenarios:** bear NOK 53 / base NOK 74 / bull NOK 103; probability-weighted NOK 76.10
**12-month target price NOK 77.00:** fair value NOK 74.00 (valued at 23.09.2026) rolled forward at the 8.3% cost of equity less NOK 3.00 dividend; expected total return +69%, rating BUY
multiples_commentary: **Trading at a premium:** 9.5x EV/EBITDA vs 9.0x peer median (6% premium)
**Earnings multiple:** 14.8x trailing P/E vs 14.7x for peers (+0%); 13.3x vs 12.9x on next-twelve-month consensus
**Versus own history:** 8.1x trailing EV/EBITDA is below the 3.5-year median of 11.3x (11% of weeks were cheaper)
**EV/EBITDA-implied value:** NOK 44.86 at the peer median of 9.0x (range 38–47 across the 25th–75th percentile)
risks: **Value drivers:** WACC ±0.5pp moves fair value to NOK 68.7–80.2, EBITDA margin ±1pp to NOK 68.4–79.6 (base NOK 74.00)
**Execution:** the case assumes 1.5% growth in 2026E and margins of 13.6% by 2031E; a return to the 2022–2025 average margin of 13.8% would cut fair value
**Macro:** consumer spending, interest rates and FX can move revenue and the discount rate simultaneously
consensus: **EPS 2026E NOK 3.60 vs consensus NOK 3.28 (+10%):** we are above the 2 analysts – outside the range of estimates; 2027E +6%; our view rests on a 13.5% 2026E EBITDA margin and a 22% tax rate
**Revenue 2026E NOK 3,970m vs consensus NOK 3,970m (-0.0%):** in line by construction – our growth is anchored on consensus, so the differentiated view sits in margins
**Estimate momentum negative:** consensus EPS over the last 90 days 2026E -4.1%, 2027E -3.2%; 2 upward and 2 downward revisions in the last 30 days
**Tension:** our BUY runs against falling consensus estimates – shares rarely re-rate before revisions turn, so the timing of the case depends on the next reports
multiples_depth: **On next-twelve-month consensus** Bouvet trades at 13.3x P/E (peers 12.9x), 1.1x EV/Sales (peers 1.2x), 8.8x EV/EBITDA at the LTM margin (peers 8.0x); PEG 1.16 vs 1.19
**Growth and margin explain 38% of the dispersion in peer EV/EBITDA** (8 peers): fundamentals justify 12.5x against the 9.0x median (+39%); the actual 9.5x leaves -24% unexplained. Evidence moderate
**Regression-implied value NOK 61.92** per share (NOK 44–80 within one residual standard deviation)
**Cash and payout:** 5.4% levered FCF yield vs 9.2% for peers; 6.3% dividend yield vs 3.3%
**Consensus EPS growth FY1:** +12% for Bouvet vs +9% for the peer median – the growth the forward multiple is buying
